title: Villa Romana del Casale, main villa and bath conservation complex
visualBrief: Main connected villa and baths conservation complex only: mapped apsidal room outline and open rectangular peristyle, 32 near-view columns, shallow dry courtyard fountain, pale infill above weathered stone ruins, grey standing-seam roofs, higher basilica/Great Hunt ranges, stepped western baths and red octagonal frigidarium roof with faceted skylight. Triclinium, Xystus rooms/court, entrance remains and two eastern latrines are separate required models. Figurative mosaics, temporary art, furniture, signage and surrounding archaeological park are not copied into this exterior model.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Q505617 identifies the archaeological park way304804695; it is not a building footprint. This independent member uses the actual main covered building relation4063362/native52776562196610, including its four-point peristyle hole. Internal X follows the long court axis east-northeast toward the basilica; internal Z points south-southeast. Native east/up/south geometry is baked with heading0. Only the main covered footprint is replaced; all detached site buildings remain independent.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Photo-led medium-fi conservation exterior. No qualified mapped heights. Working absolute floor terraces: western baths543.2m, frigidarium544.2m, peristyle545.5m, north rooms547.4m, Great Hunt548.0m, eastern rooms549.2m and basilica551.0m. These roughly follow the retained standard DEM and photographed stepped roofscape; they are reconstructed working levels, not measured ancient floors. Shelter eaves3.5–6m above their working floor and simple gables/faceted apses/skylight preserve roof forms. Wall and roof subdivisions, room inventories, exact glazing/beam spacing and unseen elevations are approximate. Shared geometric tile flooring is a generic tonal proxy, not a recreation of the villa mosaics.

reconstruction.terrainBasis: Qualified approximate native exterior fit on original Protomaps20261020/Mapzen 201x201/6m terrain. Outside-building provider internal[-20,24] supplies the 544.1027338337185m datum. Main boundary grades -1.330..10.799m require reconstructed working terraces (543.2–551.0m absolute), pale infill and closed foundations at -1.480m relative. Current native views show connected shelters, open peristyle/column bays, clear outside approaches and supported low baths; downhill foundation and partial uphill base burial remain visible. The dry courtyard basin is an approximate raised exterior proxy. Exact excavated floors, paving/stairs, water state, historic room levels and accessible transitions are unverified. Five occupied masks cover only the main building minus its courtyard plus the basin; original courtyard garden and approaches remain. Preserve all 42 resident / 43 wider independent buildings, original ground/roads and empty native water layer. No bespoke terrain or flattening.
